title: callista alpestris
intro: Callista alpestris, commonly known as the alpine orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to address various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Callista alpestris include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exerting a sedative effect. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
